requirements: Show the entire operating market as an interactive visual field.
Include prospects, active clients, active projects, and projects in process.
Help Joe and Dell combine site visits into efficient single-day trips.
Treat high-quality visual data and interaction as core adoption requirements because both partners are strongly visual.

product_objective: Give Joe and Dell a fast, spatial understanding of market activity and a safe way to assemble efficient site-visit day trips without opening Claude Code or Codex.

authority_and_truth.authoritative_source: tenant-scoped CARR records, locations, appointments, and versioned events
authority_and_truth.map_role: read projection and planning workspace only
authority_and_truth.writer_rule: The map never becomes a source of truth, never writes by dragging or pin placement, and never silently changes a prospect, client, project, appointment, address, owner, or lifecycle state.
authority_and_truth.planning_rule: A day-trip plan is a versioned proposal until Joe or Dell explicitly confirms it through the governed Tour workflow; route optimization cannot mutate canonical records.
authority_and_truth.freshness_rule: Every marker, cluster, summary, list row, and route stop carries source version, source status, precision class, and observed time. An aggregate is Mixed/Partial when any included child is stale, Unknown, unlocated, or unavailable; it reports current, stale, Unknown, and unlocated counts and never averages missing inputs into a fresh total. Stale, Unknown, unlocated, and approximate locations cannot become route stops.
authority_and_truth.tenant_rule: The server derives tenant and workspace scope. Browser bounds, URL parameters, filters, Doc, routing vendors, mobile state, and model output cannot select or widen tenant or workspace access.

covered_work_classes.label: Prospect
covered_work_classes.inclusion: authorized prospect or target record with a location suitable for its approved precision class

covered_work_classes.label: Active client
covered_work_classes.inclusion: active representation or relationship record with one or more authorized search-area or project locations

covered_work_classes.label: Project in process
covered_work_classes.inclusion: tenant-scoped work record with a current project lifecycle and authorized location

covered_work_classes.label: Active project
covered_work_classes.inclusion: active site, property, tour, or transaction location linked to a current work record

location_contract.cardinality_rule: Entity class and location meaning remain separate. One prospect, client, or project record may contribute zero, one, or many separately identified and sourced map items, including a practice location, search area, multiple candidate properties, confirmed site, and appointment stop.
location_contract.unknown_semantics: A missing, disputed, unauthorized, or unverified location renders Unknown with the reason and safe record link. It never receives a plausible synthetic coordinate in a live view.
location_contract.geocode_rule: Building and prospect-pool address fields do not currently provide canonical latitude/longitude. Geocoding is a derived, versioned projection tied to canonical address version, provider, confidence, and observed time. A geocode result never overwrites the canonical address.
location_contract.unlocated_rule: Every filter and total reports located and unlocated counts. Unlocated records enter an explicit verification queue and stay available through the equivalent list; the map never silently omits them.
location_contract.redaction_rule: Exact coordinates, addresses, client identity, and appointment details are returned only when the authenticated workspace role and redaction profile allow them. Unauthorized requests use privacy-safe not-found parity without approximate leakage.
location_contract.record_level_fields_note: work_class, accountable owner, and lifecycle_state are carried by the owning business record (one accountable owner plus a collaborators collection per the canonical item grammar), not duplicated on each location object; reconciled by the council Market Map ruling 2026-08-12 after the contract/fixture field mismatch was verified.

visual_interaction_contract.default_view: whole-market extent with a visible legend, summary counts, freshness summary, and map/list split view
required_encodings: shape or icon for work class
visual_interaction_contract.color_rule: Color may reinforce meaning but never carries category, risk, freshness, or selection by itself.
required_interactions: filter by Team Book versus National Accounts scope, work class, lifecycle, owner, market, Today/7/30-day planning horizon, freshness, Changed Since, and trip eligibility
select a marker or equivalent list row
add an eligible location to a draft day trip
clear filters and restore whole-market view
copy or share a stable tenant-safe filtered-view link
visual_interaction_contract.map_list_parity: Every visible or selected marker has one equivalent list row with the same map_item_id, class, label, lifecycle, owner, freshness, precision, selection, and deep link. Filtering, selection, focus, and trip inclusion stay bidirectionally synchronized.
visual_interaction_contract.cluster_rule: Clusters are computed only after tenant/workspace authorization and field redaction. They distinguish record count from location count, preserve co-located records and multi-location records, and expose the same members through an accessible keyboard list without leaking excluded counts.
visual_interaction_contract.temporal_filter_rule: Planning horizon (Today, 7 days, 30 days) is separate from record freshness and Changed Since. No date-window choice changes source freshness or implies recent activity.
visual_interaction_contract.no_false_visual_precision: Marker styling and zoom limits disclose approximate precision; centroids never appear as exact sites.

phase0_fixture_claim: The bounded Phase 0 synthetic fixture must prove the strict canonical nested shape, mixed freshness, multi-location records, explicit unlocated work, all four record classes including active_project, and transparent skipped-stop evidence. Provider-backed optimization, live traffic, production clustering, full pan/zoom, route alternatives, planning fingerprint enforcement, and observed human adoption remain future gates unless separately demonstrated.

planning_inputs: manual include, exclude, and priority choices
day_trip_planning_contract.optimization_objective: Minimize total travel and schedule risk while preserving locked appointments, required buffers, human priorities, and a feasible workday; never claim a mathematically optimal route without provider evidence.
day_trip_planning_contract.provider_direction: The current Tour roadmap prefers Google routing. Council may ratify Google or require a measured vendor comparison. Google Compute Routes supports waypoint reordering; Route Optimization supports time-window and multi-stop field-service constraints. Neither capability removes the human gate or proves mathematical optimality or current traffic without fresh response evidence.
day_trip_planning_contract.current_cost_observation: Time-sensitive 2026-08-12 vendor evidence: Google Compute Routes Pro and single-vehicle Route Optimization each advertise 5,000 free monthly billable events then $10 per 1,000 at the first paid tier; Compute Routes Essentials advertises 10,000 free then $5 per 1,000. Construction requires fresh pricing verification, an approved billing account, per-session and monthly caps, alerts, and a deterministic degraded path.
proposal_outputs: ordered numbered stops with map/list parity
guards: Unknown or unauthorized locations are excluded with a visible reason.
A stale travel-time source is labeled and cannot support a Live claim.
A flexible stop cannot displace a locked appointment.
The planner does not infer partner availability or appointment duration from silence.
A material input change invalidates prior route confirmation.
External calendar, navigation, message, or appointment changes require their own governed human-approved action.
day_trip_planning_contract.tour_handoff: A confirmed trip proposal creates or updates the exact governed Tour record through the future shared business service, preserves the planning fingerprint, and then follows the existing Tour confirmation, offline-pack, execution, sync, and review gates.

responsive_and_accessibility.desktop: Large split view with map, synchronized list, filters, selected-record panel, and trip-builder rail.
responsive_and_accessibility.tablet: Adaptive map/list master-detail; route planning remains available before native iPad Tour Mode construction.
responsive_and_accessibility.phone: Map and list are separate full-height modes with persistent filter/selection summary; production trip approval is permitted only if the future role/risk contract allows it, while Control Room production approvals remain prohibited.
responsive_and_accessibility.keyboard: All markers are reachable through the synchronized list; selection, filtering, trip inclusion, and record opening require no pointer gesture.
responsive_and_accessibility.screen_reader: The map has a concise summary and change announcements; the equivalent list exposes every item, filter, route order, exclusion, and warning.
responsive_and_accessibility.zoom_and_motion: Supports 200 percent zoom, 44-pixel targets, reduced motion, high contrast, and no essential animated-only explanation.
responsive_and_accessibility.adoption_gate: Joe and Dell each complete whole-market scan, exact-record retrieval, filter, trip assembly, route comparison, and owning-record handoff uncoached, with map/list parity and no heavy AI session.

protections: tenant and business-workspace scope on every map item, query, route candidate, itinerary, cache, export, audit event, and routing-vendor request
server-side field allow-list before routing-vendor egress
no client names or deal facts in third-party routing labels
no public map URLs containing record IDs or sensitive coordinates
encrypted device cache with explicit expiry and remote invalidation
payload-free audit for view, selection, route proposal, confirmation, denial, and redaction
privacy-safe response parity across map, list, search, Doc, export, mobile, local-edge, and background paths
privacy_and_security.sterile_mode: The whole-market map is structurally unavailable in sterile or client-facing mode. Only an explicit client-scoped tour may show its authorized minimum-necessary pins. Presentation suppression never grants access or changes authoritative redaction.

provider_portability_and_terms_gate.canonical_geometry: CARR-owned postal address, manually approved service/search areas, and source geometry remain vendor-independent canonical inputs. Provider-derived coordinates and route results are isolated projections with provider, version, confidence, terms class, expiry, and observed time.
provider_portability_and_terms_gate.google_policy_observation: Time-sensitive 2026-08-12 planning evidence indicates Google geocoding content is subject to storage and caching restrictions, commonly including approximately 30-day latitude/longitude caching unless a narrow exception applies; Place IDs may be stored longer. Google geocoding content also carries Google-map, attribution, Terms, and Privacy Policy constraints.
construction_gate: Fresh legal and product-terms review for the exact Maps, Geocoding, Routes, and Route Optimization SKUs.
Document which fields may be stored, for how long, and under which end-user exception.
Prevent Google-derived geocode content from rendering on an incompatible non-Google map.
Render required attribution and link the applicable Terms and Privacy Policy.
Prove purge/refresh jobs and vendor-specific projection isolation.
Prove a provider exit path can regenerate projections from canonical CARR inputs without rewriting business records.
Obtain Joe approval for billing account, per-session and monthly caps, alerts, and degraded behavior.
provider_portability_and_terms_gate.cost_gate: Dated list pricing is planning evidence only. At Joe/Dell scale usage may remain inside free monthly caps, but no zero-cost claim is permitted before measured calls, SKU classification, billing reports, and overage alerts.

prototype_boundary.map_tiles: CSS synthetic visual; no live tile, geocoding, traffic, calendar, or navigation vendor
prototype_boundary.production_claim: The Phase 0 prototype proves contract shape and interaction intent only. It does not prove live data completeness, routing quality, vendor terms, privacy posture, accessibility, or adoption.

uncoached_acceptance_journeys: Scan the whole authorized Team Book market, distinguish records from locations, expand a co-located cluster by keyboard, and verify map/list member parity.
Switch Team Book/National Accounts scope and prove server-scoped isolation without carrying filters, counts, or selected records across boundaries.
Interpret a Mixed/Partial market summary showing exact current, stale, Unknown, and unlocated counts; open the unlocated verification queue without false map omission.
Use separate Today/7/30-day and Changed Since/freshness filters to find compatible site visits without conflating schedule with currency.
Build a day trip where a stale, approximate, or infeasible stop is excluded; read skipped-stop reasons, provider/time/model inputs, buffers, and alternatives; refuse optimal or Live claims.

Enter sterile/client-facing mode and prove the whole-market map, clusters, export, Doc context, vendor egress, and caches are unavailable while an explicit client-scoped tour shows only authorized pins.
